# Civensa

> Evidence-led research on UK public procurement: buyer intent, contract renewals, supplier requirements and market structure.

Civensa is an independent research publication operated by BidSkim Limited. It connects public procurement evidence across buyer plans, contract cycles, supplier requirements and market structure. Analysis distinguishes published facts, calculated milestones and qualified interpretation.

## Primary pages

- [Research](https://civensa.com/research/): All Civensa research notes.
- [Methodology](https://civensa.com/methodology/): Source hierarchy, evidence standards and limitations.
- [Compare approaches](https://civensa.com/compare/): Transparent comparison of procurement research approaches.
- [About](https://civensa.com/about/): Publication purpose and operating entity.

## Research notes

- [Why renewal signals matter before a tender is published](https://civensa.com/research/renewal-signals/)
- [Reading the buyer before reading the opportunity](https://civensa.com/research/buyer-intelligence/)
- [Requirements are a market signal, not an admin task](https://civensa.com/research/supplier-requirements/)

## Citation and contact

When citing Civensa, preserve the article title, canonical URL and publication date. Contact research@civensa.com for research queries.
